issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares the Ride attributes as private ('-name: String' and '-abbreviation: char'), but the solution implementation declares the 'name' attribute as public (public String name). This is a visibility mismatch that can confuse students about the intended encapsulation (they will expect private fields with public getters as implied by the UML) and may lead to inconsistent implementations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the 'name' attribute private in the implementation (private String name) to match the UML (private attributes) and rely on the public getter getName() for access. Ensure the template and solution are consistent in the visibility of Ride attributes.
